predictions.rationale: Defines the core abstraction "Critic" representing the design‐analysis agents; central to creating, running and evaluating design critics.
Provides a composite implementation of multiple Critic objects, showing advanced critic behaviour and reuse; essential to critic functionality.
Represents the "designer" agent that coordinates model analysis and invokes critics during background processing.
Manages registration and scheduling of Critic instances; acts as the agency that lets them run continuously.
Bootstraps and launches the background critic thread when ArgoUML starts, directly supporting live critique.
Holds the collection of suggested improvements produced by critics, forming the user-visible feedback list.
Represents individual critic findings (issues) shown to the user; tightly coupled to critic output.
Initialises and registers the large set of UML-specific critic subclasses with the Agency at startup.
Abstracts the control mechanism that decides when critics fire, directly influencing continuous background analysis.
Default implementation of ControlMech that schedules critics; essential for normal operation of design critics.
